lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Circular high-luminance nodes are arranged in multiple structured, roughly parallel vertical columns along the posterior flank and caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity align with and intersect the high-luminance circular nodes, forming a rectilinear grid-like arrangement.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible along the upper third of the visible flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition with high-intensity light on the superior edge and deep shadow on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The caudal fin exhibits a continued pattern of high-luminance blobs that decrease in size and intensity toward the posterior trailing edges of both the upper and lower lobes.
